caption: The drawing depicts a round, copper-colored object with a short cylindrical handle extending from one side. The main body is a shallow, slightly domed disc featuring a central circular opening, which contains a dark, curved, fan-like structure inside. Surrounding this central opening are several small black dots evenly spaced around the surface of the disc. The attached handle appears solid and is rendered in a similar copper color. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a light, sketched outline of a different object, which appears to be an old-fashioned oil lamp with a wide circular top and a tall, narrow glass chimney emerging from a rounded base; the handle and round disc from the main colored object are suggested as being part of this lamp in the sketch. The background is a plain, light beige with some faint shadowing.
title: Warming Pan
